req.title: Return GET request metadata
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /get with a JSON object containing the request's URL, headers, arguments, and origin IP.
expected_outcomes: JSON body with keys url, args, headers, origin
error_pathways: HTTP 405 if a non-GET method is used

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /get returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing exactly the keys 'url', 'args', 'headers', and 'origin'. Error pathway requires HTTP 405 for non-GET methods. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — plain GET returns 200 with all four required keys present and non-null; (2) positive EP with query args — args dict reflects query string exactly; (3) negative NEG — POST to /get returns 405; (4) negative NEG — PUT to /get returns 405; (5) BVA — GET with zero query params yields empty args dict (not None, not missing); (6) DT — custom request header is reflected in the headers key; (7) BVA — GET with exactly one query param yields single-value args dict. Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill constant, operator-flip, and key-omission mutations.

tests.name: test_get_returns_200_with_required_keys
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
No special headers or query parameters
actions: Issue GET /get with no query parameters
expected: JSON body does NOT contain extra keys beyond the four required
trace: R-HTTPBIN-001: 'JSON body with keys url, args, headers, origin; HTTP 200'
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_returns_200_with_required_keys():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in r.content_type
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'url' in body
    assert 'args' in body
    assert 'headers' in body
    assert 'origin' in body
    assert set(body.keys()) == {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'origin'}

test_get_returns_200_with_required_keys()

from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_reflects_query_args_exactly():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get?foo=bar')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert body['args'] == {'foo': 'bar'}
    assert 'foo=bar' in body['url']

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_reflects_custom_request_header():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get', headers={'X-Test-Header': 'sentinel-value'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert isinstance(body['headers'], dict)
    headers_lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in body['headers'].items()}
    assert headers_lower.get('x-test-header') == 'sentinel-value'

test_get_reflects_custom_request_header()
